feedback.intrinsic: The rules would block GPT-Image-1 from the image workflows it is meant to support.
feedback.instructional: GPT-Image models create and edit still images. Sora models generate video.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. The right rule separates draft needs like cost or speed from final brand needs like visual accuracy.

payload.prompt: A developer is preparing a Python app that generates campaign images in Foundry from user prompts. Which items belong in the setup?

options.rationale: The app needs a Foundry resource to access the deployed model. The resource provides the endpoint used by the code.
The code passes the deployment name as the model value. This tells the request which deployed image generation model to use.

options.text: Authentication by API key or Microsoft Entra ID
options.rationale: The app must authenticate to call the Foundry resource. Authentication can use an API key or Microsoft Entra ID.

options.error_type: confuses image generation setup with video job retrieval
options.rationale: A video id is used when polling or downloading a generated video. It is not part of setting up a Python app that generates still images from prompts.
options.better_fit: Use a video id when retrieving a generated video after a video job has completed.

feedback.intrinsic: The developer may prepare for a video retrieval workflow instead of the image generation setup.
feedback.instructional: For Python image generation, focus on the resource, deployment name, and authentication. Video ids belong to asynchronous video jobs.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Python image generation setup needs a Foundry resource, a deployed model name, and authentication.

payload.prompt: A designer has an existing product image and wants the app to revise it, create variants, and also make new images from descriptions. Which GPT-Image-1 capabilities support that need?

options.rationale: Precise image editing supports revising an existing image. That matches the designer's need to change a product image.
Image variations support creating alternate versions of an image. This directly fits the request to create variants.
Text-to-image generation creates new images from descriptions. That fits the designer's need to make new images from written prompts.

options.error_type: confuses image model capabilities with video REST jobs
options.rationale: Video status polling is part of asynchronous video generation. It is not a GPT-Image-1 capability for revising, varying, or creating still images.
options.better_fit: Use polling after starting a video generation job.

feedback.intrinsic: The designer's app plan would include a video workflow step that does not help revise product images.
feedback.instructional: GPT-Image-1 supports still image generation, variations, and precise editing. Polling belongs to video jobs that take time to complete.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. GPT-Image-1 supports editing, variations, and text-to-image generation for still image work.

payload.prompt: A media team needs original visuals for publishing. They want to explain why image generation fits better than image analysis. Which statements support that choice?

options.text: It can create original images from descriptions
options.rationale: Image generation models create images that correspond to text descriptions. That fits original visuals for publishing.
Text-to-image inferencing is the process of generating images from text. It explains why written descriptions can become visual output.

options.text: It reverses matching images to text
options.rationale: Some visual models match information in an image to related text. Image generation reverses that by creating images from text descriptions.

options.text: It only highlights objects in photos
options.error_type: confuses image generation with image analysis
options.rationale: Highlighting objects in existing photos is an analysis task. The media team needs original visuals, so generation is the better fit.
options.better_fit: Choose analysis when the task is to identify objects or interpret scenes in existing images.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would explain the choice using an analysis task instead of a creation task.
feedback.instructional: Image analysis works with visuals that already exist. Image generation creates new visuals from descriptions.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. Image generation is the right fit when the goal is to create original visuals from descriptions.
